listingFacts:
Airbnb title: Cozy Retreat in Lisbon Falls. Entire home in Lisbon, Maine. Up to 4 guests; 2 bedrooms, 2 beds, 1 bath. Bedroom 1: king bed (listing photo caption says medium-firm mattress). Bedroom 2: queen bed. Hosted by Kaily, Superhost; listing shows 5 years hosting. Listing describes a simple, welcoming home with fully equipped kitchen, comfy living room and peaceful atmosphere. Property sits on a quiet one-acre lot with spacious front yard, set back from Main Street. Neighbor shares driveway entrance and has five acres. Guests have access to entire home and property. Listing highlights Wi-Fi, dedicated workspace, free parking on premises, pets allowed, window AC unit. Listing says all amenities are simple and the home has lived-in qualities. No smoking inside; smoking outside is allowed; listing states a $200 cleaning fee if smoking occurs indoors. Nearby areas named by listing: Lisbon Falls, Brunswick, Freeport, Portland and Maine coast. Fresh Airbnb page shows 4.94 rating from 49 reviews, matching all 49 supplied entries. The host highlighted ten amenities for prominent placement; use four as top points of interest and show the full deduplicated amenity list near the top. Safety disclosures and complete house rules were not exposed in the fetched page and need source confirmation. Host-highlighted amenities supplied directly: Wifi; dedicated workspace; free parking on premises; pets allowed; window AC unit; bathtub; backyard; refrigerator; microwave; long term stays allowed. Full Airbnb amenity categories and items were supplied in chat, and washer, dryer, soap, and a very good TV were separately confirmed by the user. Preserve the distinction in source notes.
Fresh Airbnb rule and safety panels, read October 19, 2026: Check-in after 3 PM; checkout before 11 AM; self check-in with lockbox. Four guests maximum. House-trained dogs allowed; cats not allowed. Quiet hours 9 PM–7 AM. No parties or events. No indoor smoking; the description permits smoking outside. Indoor smoking fee $200. Eat meals in the dining area, not on beds. Damaged linens fee $75; damaged duvet cover and insert fee $150. Leave the space neat: wash dishes, wipe counters, bag trash, and place used towels in the bathroom. No deep cleaning required; excessive mess can incur a cleaning fee. Stolen items can incur a fee; amount not specified. Before leaving: gather used towels, strip beds, wash dirty dishes, set thermostat to 50 (unit unspecified in listing), turn things off, return keys, and lock up. Smoke and carbon monoxide alarms installed. Cancellation details depend on selected trip dates.
